title: Farstrand - The Strand
message:
FARSTRAND strand ride "The Strand".
D minor, 140 BPM. Orders 1-4 loop.
The hook is the Farstrand title motif in the HELIOBANE 3-3-2; C quotes HELIOBANE stage 1.
All samples synthesized. Source: songs/farstrand_strand.gen.js
